target_api.api_description: Future weather API method returns weather in a 3 hourly interval in future for a date between 14 days and 300 days from today in the future.

parameters.name: dt
parameters.description: 'dt' should be between 14 days and 300 days from today in the future in yyyy-MM-dd format (i.e. dt=2023-01-01)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Query parameter based on which data is sent back. It could be following:

Latitude and Longitude (Decimal degree) e.g: q=48.8567,2.3508
city name e.g.: q=Paris
US zip e.g.: q=10001
UK postcode e.g: q=

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Returns 'condition:text' field in API in the desired language

- d

target_api.api_description:
Get closest block to a timestamp

Runs binary search over a blockchain's blocks to get the closest one to a timestamp.

Every time this is run we add new data to our database, so each query permanently speeds up future queries.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Chain which you want to get the block from

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: UNIX timestamp of the block you are searching for

parameters.description: "amount" parameter - append the amount to convert to VAT compliant price

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: Option 1 - define country by 2-letter country code

parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.description: Option 2 - define country by IP address

parameters.name: use_client_ip
parameters.description: Option 3 - set to "1" in order to use the IP of the client making the API request

parameters.name: incl
parameters.description: set to "1" in case your amount already contains the respective VAT percentage

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: define a reduced VAT "type" (product category) according to the API's "type" endpoint

source_api.api_description: Shifts  a date or a datetime in the future or past.

parameters.name: weekday
parameters.description: Allows to shift a date to the specified next or previous Nth weekday. It should be one of the weekday instances (SU, MO, TU, WE, TH, FR, SA). These instances may receive a parameter N, specifying the

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: The number of hours before(negative value) or after(positive value) start_date.

parameters.name: microseconds
parameters.description: The number of microseconds before(negative value) or after(positive value) start_date.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: The number of seconds before(negative value) or after(positive value) start_date.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: The number of minutes before(negative value) or after(positive value) start_date.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: The number of days before(negative value) or after(positive value) start_date.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: The number of months before(negative value) or after(positive value) start_date.

parameters.name: weeks
parameters.description: The number of weeks before(negative value) or after(positive value) start_date.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: The number of years before(negative value) or after(positive value) start_date.

target_api.api_description:
Fetch candle data for a single trading pair.

You need to resolve the symbolic trading pair name to `pair_id` primary key with `/pairs` or `/pair-details`
to call this API endpoint.

Candle response size is limited to 10,000 candles. Only the first 10,000 candles
since the start timestamp is return

parameters.name: time_bucket
parameters.description: What time bucket to use for the candle size.

parameters.name: pair_id
parameters.description:
Primary key for the trading pair

For tests and demos use id `1` which is ETH/USDC pair on Uniswap v2,
as it is the first deployed Uniswap v2 compatible pool.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description:
When the candle fetch period starts.

Use UNIX UTC timestamp, as ISO 8601 formatted string.
[Read more information about the time format](https://docs.python.org/3/library/datetime.html#datetime.date

parameters.name: end
parameters.description:
When the candle fetch period ends.

Use UNIX UTC timestamp, as ISO 8601 formatted string.

If not specific this will be resolved to now().

This range parameter is inclusive.

parameters.name: page

Default is `1`

parameters.name: countryIsoCode

format YYYYMMDD

parameters.description: Number of days should be from 1 to 30, and will restrict your results to the most recent number of days you provide as the variable.

parameters.name: beginningInjDate
parameters.description:
format YYYYMMDD
Use this to restrict date range. This date is inclusive and the beginning of the date range.

parameters.name: playerID
parameters.description:
Numerical playerID
Restricts results to a specific player only.

parameters.name: injDate
parameters.description:
format YYYYMMDD
Use this if you want to restrict your results to only one date

- To use **sec_uid** use input field **BELOW**

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description:
Limit the output number of records. 

- Default is 100
- Max number is 500

parameters.name: max_cursor
parameters.description:
Pagination cursor. 
To get more videos, paste here **max_cursor** value that you have received in previous request response.

parameters.description:
**NOTE:** By using **sec_uid**, request will be executed faster then if you will use username

**NOTE:** **sec_uid** can be obtained from the **User Information** endpoint
